capabilities: Chat with local Ollama models using layered topic memory
Route queries to relevant memory topics and resolve detail levels progressively
Execute natural-language document write, move, delete, and reorganization commands
Research topics across web pages and write findings up as documents
Extract entities, facts, and relationships into a queryable knowledge base
disambiguation: Not a library or reference manager; the name refers to an AI chat system with layered memory, not a book-cataloging tool.
extras: Free and open source; the author requests donations. Web crawling is the plugin's only non-local network call and can be toggled off for a fully offline setup. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, and local LLM chats lose context between sessions without a persistent, scalable memory store.

relations.evidence: it talks to a local Ollama server for chat, summarization, and embeddings
trigger a lightweight search against DuckDuckGo's no-JS HTML endpoint

summary: Local-LLM chat orchestrator that gives Ollama-backed chats persistent layered memory, vault search, and natural-language document management.
